retry_policy: Stay at battle node until server verifies victory; retries are same intent, not new completion.
replay_policy: Separate replay session; cannot mutate canonical choices, quest progress, event completion, or future reward claims.
alternative_route_policy: Post-completion replay of 4 route scenes and 2 battles, with optional matching Act 5 callback; shared story remains viewable without replaying it.
migration_policy: Stable scene/line/node/choice IDs; pin in-progress revision. On incompatible change restart current scene with notice, preserving completed nodes and original choices. Never remint rewards.
